description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5331015412160 O-RING: Line 0001 Qty 1330 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0128 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 199. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 1EFH8 10025382; 64678 29542976; 73342 29542976. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
